parameters.query:
-- Failure messages of the last 3 days with their live (not undone) decision, if
-- any: the class W3 posted, and who decided what (EXPERIENCE.md M13).
SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
         'nightly_run_id', m.nightly_run_id::text, 'test_id', m.test_id, 'class', m.class,
         'action', d.action, 'state', d.state, 'actor_id', d.actor_id, 'actor_name', d.actor_name,
         'reason', d.reason, 'jira_key', d.jira_key
       ) ORDER BY m.created_at, m.id), '[]') AS decisions
FROM audit.message_map m
LEFT JOIN audit.reaction_decisions d ON d.map_id = m.id AND d.undone_at IS NULL
WHERE m.kind = 'failure' AND m.created_at > now() - interval '3 days';
